name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Curl
steps: Lean back on an incline bench and hold dumbbells beside your hips with your thumbs pointing forward.
Bend both elbows and curl the dumbbells upward with your palms facing each other.
Lower them until your arms hang comfortably beside you.
tips: Keep your elbows from drifting forward toward your chest.
Keep your shoulders resting against the backrest and your wrists neutral throughout.
